text_block_list.text: The day has arrived for the autumn Tenno Sho, where Maruzensky will compete with Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The highly anticipated bout has finally arrived! Maruzensky heads to the track, knowing she is about to have an exhilarating race.
